titles.title: Soldiers' and Sailors' Civil Relief Act Amendments of 1990
Soldiers' and Sailors' Civil Relief Act Amendments of 1990

A bill to amend the Soldier's and Sailors' Civil Relief Act of 1940 to improve and clarify the protections provided by such Act and to make technical amendments; to amend title 38, United States Code, to clarify veterans' reemployment rights and to improve veterans' rights to reinstatement of health insurance, and for other purposes.
